verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is documented as an AI assistant that lets users tune, control, and optimize their GeForce RTX PC, implying natural-language command operation, but it's labeled a 'Project' (experimental) with no detail on command scope or independent hands-on verification. Missing for 10: concrete examples of natural-language commands in action, confirmation G-Assist is generally available (not just a preview), and independent/community corroboration of its usability.
